title: Assert no stray durable writes in awaitable clear test (saved list unasserted)
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:760, 770: the clear test's persist_rollback_state=saved.append capture is never asserted. Cheap pin that the rejected clear transition performed no stray durable writes beyond the one legitimate install: assert len(saved) == 1 after the rejection (and it documents that the capture is load-bearing rather than vestigial).
